intro: The Cheesecake Factory is famous for two things: an enormous menu of 250-plus dishes, from appetizers and pasta to steaks and Tex-Mex, and more than 30 flavors of its legendary cheesecake. Portions are huge and so are the calorie counts. Below is a guide to popular Cheesecake Factory menu items with prices and calories for 2026.
quick_answer: The Cheesecake Factory has one of the biggest menus in dining, with 250-plus items. Mains like Orange Chicken ($21.95) and Chicken Madeira ($25.95) come in huge portions, appetizers run about $16 to $20, and a slice of the famous cheesecake is $10.50 to $12.50. Portions are large and calorie counts are high.
hot_deal: Cheesecake Factory value tips: portions are big enough to split, and weekday lunch specials offer smaller plates at lower prices. Don't leave without a slice of cheesecake, from the Original ($10.50) to the Oreo Dream Extreme ($11.95). National Cheesecake Day brings half-price slices. Offers vary by location.

faqs.q: How big is the Cheesecake Factory menu?
faqs.a: The Cheesecake Factory menu has more than 250 items, from appetizers and pasta to steaks, seafood and Tex-Mex, plus over 30 flavors of cheesecake. It is one of the largest menus of any major chain.

faqs.q: How much is a slice of cheesecake at the Cheesecake Factory?
faqs.a: A slice runs about $10.50 for the Original up to $12.50 for premium flavors like the Godiva Chocolate Cheesecake. On National Cheesecake Day, slices are often half price.

faqs.q: What is the most popular dish at the Cheesecake Factory?
faqs.a: The Chicken Madeira is the signature entree, and the Avocado Eggrolls are the most ordered appetizer. The Original Cheesecake is the best-selling dessert.

faqs.q: Does the Cheesecake Factory have lunch specials?
faqs.a: Yes. On weekdays, the Cheesecake Factory offers smaller lunch portions of many dishes at lower prices, a good way to try the big menu for less.

faqs.q: Why are Cheesecake Factory calories so high?
faqs.a: Portions are very large, so single dishes can run well over 1,500 calories, and some pastas top 2,000. Many diners split entrees or take half home, and the SkinnyLicious menu offers lighter options.
